1.web: “Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over Yahweh’s house, because they have broken my covenant, and rebelled against my law.
1.asv: Setthe trumpet to thy mouth. As an eagle he cometh against the house of Jehovah, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.

2.web: They cry to me, ‘My God, we Israel acknowledge you!’
2.asv: They shall cry unto me, My God, we Israel know thee.

3.web: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.
3.asv: Israel hath cast off that which is good: the enemy shall pursue him.

4.web: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.
4.asv: They have set up kings, but not by me; they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.

5.web: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?
5.asv: He hath cast off thy calf, O Samaria; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?

6.web: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
6.asv: For from Israel is even this; the workman made it, and it is no God; yea, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

7.web: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.
7.asv: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: he hath no standing grain; the blade shall yield no meal; if so be it yield, strangers shall swallow it up.

8.web: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
8.asv: Israel is swallowed up: now are they among the nations as a vessel wherein none delighteth.

9.web: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.
9.asv: For they are gone up to Assyria, like a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.

10.web: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.
10.asv: Yea, though they hire among the nations, now will I gather them; and they begin to be diminished by reason of the burden of the king of princes.

11.web: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.
11.asv: Because Ephraim hath multiplied altars for sinning, altars have been unto him for sinning.

12.web: I wrote for him the many things of my law; but they were regarded as a strange thing.
12.asv: I wrote for him the ten thousand things of my law; but they are counted as a strange thing.

13.web: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice flesh and eat it; But Yahweh doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.
13.asv: As for the sacrifices of mine offerings, they sacrifice flesh and eat it; but Jehovah accepteth them not: now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins; they shall return to Egypt.

14.web: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses.”
14.asv: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and builded palaces; and Judah hath multiplied fortified cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the castles thereof.
